GRR.headline: Dense fog this morning; heavy rain threat tonight and this weekend

areas.label: Patchy dense fog
areas.quote:
The greatest fog 
potential looks to be areas east of US131, especially near and 
south of I96.[

areas.label: Showers/storms, heavy rain tonight
areas.quote:
This will being the best shower and thunderstorm potential along and 
south of I96, especially near I94.

areas.label: 1-2"+ rain, southern half
areas.quote:
Probabilistic data shows a 70-80% chance of over 1" of rain across 
much of the area with a 40-50% chance of exceeding 2" mainly across 
the southern half.

DTX.headline: Showers/storms near Detroit corridor; heavy rain risk Saturday

areas.label: Showers, rumbles of thunder
areas.quote: The cold front stalls near the southern Great Lakes this evening, sustaining a chance for showers and storms mainly near Lake Erie into tonight and Thursday.

areas.label: Heavy rainfall potential Saturday
areas.quote: The latest Excessive Rainfall Outlook products have been highlighting a Slight risk for a good portion of Southeast Michigan.

areas.label: High waves, southern Lake Huron
areas.quote: Given the long fetch into southern Lake Huron, will monitor the need for a Small Craft Advisory for high waves reaching the nearshore waters Friday morning.

APX.headline: Heaviest weekend rain likely stays south of M-72

areas.label: Heavy rain chance south of M-72
areas.quote: Residual moisture from this wave could spark some showers at times, but current thinking is the heaviest rainfall across the region would likely hold south of M-72.

MQT.headline: Quiet week; light rain chances tonight and over southern UP Fri-Sat

areas.label: Rain chances, southern UP
areas.quote: The next chances at rain arrive Friday and Saturday with another shortwave, though the current NBM keeps PoPs above 35% confined to the southern half of the UP and each of the last 3 runs has trended slightly south with the track of precipitation.

areas.label: NE gusts 20-25 kt W Lake Superior
areas.quote: During the day Friday through Saturday afternoon, wind gusts to 20-25 kt are expected over far western Lake Superior as easterly and northeasterly winds funnel between the MN Arrowhead and the Bayfield Peninsula.
